text:
Lina: Heads-up — AmpleHealth onboarding flagged three recurring asks this week: per-route billing toggle, clearer CSV cost exports, and embeddings staleness on long-lived indexes. Captured raw notes here: https://redwood.internal/cs/notes/amplehealth (private).

Sam: Thanks Lina — which of those looks like a renewal risk vs. nice-to-have?

Lina: Renewal risk = CSV cost export clarity. Customer can't reconcile route-level charges with their finance team; they said if we can't produce per-route lines + timestamps they won't renew the pilot. :worried:

Oliver: Got it. For embedding staleness, can we add a TTL/refresh flag on the index side? That's lower-priority if export is blocking renewals.

Jess: Agree — export first. I can surface the finance example (they pasted a sample ledger) into the intake doc.

Nora: Proposed triage rubric for these CS->Product asks: 
- Severity: renewal blocker / adoption blocker / minor UX
- Frequency: # of accounts in last 30 days (CS logs)
- Effort: estimate in engineer-days
- Quick-win potential: config toggle / docs / product change

Sam: Love it. Can we also map to the Priority Ladder (P0/P1/P2) and include a suggested rollout plan?

Lina: I'll score them now: CSV export = P0 (renewal risk, freq=3, effort ~3-5d), per-route billing toggle = P1 (freq=5, effort~5d), embeddings refresh TTL = P2 (freq=2, effort~3d).

FeedbackBot: Automated note — created product backlog ticket RF-423 with Lina's P0 context and attached sample ledger.

Oliver: For implementation, option A = generate per-route breakdown at ingestion time and store aggregate rows; option B = reconstruct via billing pipeline on-demand. A is simpler for correctness but needs storage change. Sharing quick CSV prototype header as discussed:
```
account_id,route_id,timestamp,request_id,tokens,model,cost_usd
```

Sam: Can you drop that prototype into the product ticket and estimate effort? I'll pair with eng on scoping.

Jess: I'll schedule a 30m sync with AmpleHealth next Tue to show proposed CSV; want Nora + Sam there?

Nora: I'll be there. Lina please include the sample ledger and any screenshots.

Lina: Added ledger and a short transcript. Thanks all. Action items:
- Lina: attach docs to RF-423 (done)
- Sam + Oliver: 1-week tech spike to choose A vs B (assign by EOD)
- Jess + Nora: customer sync Tue 10am PT

Sam: :thumbsup:

Oliver: I'll carve out time tomorrow for the spike.

FeedbackBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 7 days on RF-423.

Lina: Closing the loop here — I'll post a short summary in the weekly CS->Product rollup once we have spike outcome.

Sam: Great thread — thanks Lina.
